description: Windows codec pack that installs audio and video codecs, DirectShow filters, subtitle support, and related media utilities.
notes: Review status: the official website lists the standard StarCodec 20261016 package (45.5 MB), plus separate Lite and Classic variants. A separate 64-bit package is published on another page and is not included in this manifest.

The official download link points to the version-specific downloading.php endpoint. The final binary URL/redirect, SHA-256, installer engine, silent-install arguments, installed file layout, codec registration, and uninstall behavior have not been verified. No hash, bin, shortcut, or installer instructions are guessed.

This staged manifest is outside bucket/ and is not installable. Keep it under review until the official download can be obtained and inspected, the SHA-256 is calculated, and the install/uninstall process is tested. StarCodec warns that installing multiple codec packs can cause conflicts and recommends avoiding an unnecessary Full installation.
